thesis: The discussion argues that while current Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful machines, they are not yet equivalent to human intelligence and possess clear limitations that require significant manual work, such as labeling and creating RL environments, to overcome. Consequently, the speakers suggest that true intelligence has not been cracked and that the era is currently defined by brute force rather than true intelligence, though functional automation of many jobs is expected to be achieved within the next year or two.
